title: Can you remove the gray tint from menu options in RPG Maker MZ ?

posts.author: Berylstone
posts.body:
This is a little hard for me to explain so I'll use pictures.
RPG Maker MV:
RPG Maker MZ:
Is there a way I can remove the grayish tint that covers the menu options in RPG Maker MZ so that it appears the same way as it did in RPG Maker MV?  Note: I don't mind the brighter hue that appears over the selected Continue option in the picture.  It's the coloring that appears over all menu options (rather selected or not) that I'd like to remove.
